description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'ReadArticleScreen' used for displaying and reading a news article within an app. It manages web content display via WebView, text-to-speech functionality with voice and speed controls, and user actions like sharing and saving articles.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple class encapsulating the news article data passed to the read screen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a news article in a WebView and provides controls for text-to-speech, sharing, and saving the article.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: The state class for ReadArticleScreen, handling WebView, TTS configuration, user interactions, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A widget providing a popup menu for controlling TTS playback, speed, and voice selection.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Initializes text-to-speech engine with language and speech rate.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles user actions from the 'More' menu: sharing, saving, browsing.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Constructs the text to be spoken, including a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Starts TTS speaking the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS speech rate and initiates speaking.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS voice based on user selection and starts speaking.
